## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (no skipped or deleted tests)
- [ ] `docs/spec.md` is updated if behaviour changed, and `DECISIONS.md` if I made a choice the spec left open
- [ ] A line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md` if users will notice the change
- [ ] No security rule in `AGENTS.md` is weakened; new dependencies are pinned exactly
